name: monamotron
description: Monamotron is a portable AI skill for code-drawn animated visual explanations and real video export.

scripts.build: npm run build:solar && npm run build:neural
scripts.check:browser: npm run check:browser:solar && npm run check:browser:neural
scripts.export:neural: node skill/monamotron/scripts/export.mjs --input examples/neural-network/index.html --out examples/neural-network/exports --png --svg --video --width 1600 && node scripts/sync-public-media.mjs
